{{Top|leg}}
'''Raquitayben''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]]. She was the sole survivor of the destruction of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and was subsequently adopted by [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. She eventually chose to join the [[Iskalonian]] [[The School|School]] to live with [[Water/Legends|water]] breathers.
